description: Translate client messages and polish English drafts on supported Upwork message and feedback pages. This browser companion connects Chrome or Edge to MacHelper on your Mac. You review changes and send messages yourself.
capabilities: Polish English drafts with a preview
Use MacHelper's shared provider and model
Send messages and feedback only yourself
exampleQueries: Help me write more professional replies to clients on Upwork.
Translate a client's Upwork message before I reply.
Improve my English feedback draft without sending it.
limitations: Works only on supported Upwork pages in Chrome or Edge on a Mac.
Does not send messages or submit feedback automatically.
installSteps: Install and open MacHelper on your Mac.
Download and unzip the browser extension source.
Open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Choose Load unpacked and select the extracted MessageHelper-Upwork folder.
Open the extension settings and check the connection to MacHelper. Only you send messages or submit feedback.
